name: Research Starter
description: An analysis that says what is in the first .csv in data/ and draws a chart of it -- press Run Analysis -- and a place for the question, the notes and what you found.
_report_note: How the report looks when the child presses Show the report or Export PDF: the title, its size, the order of the parts, which charts. Data in the project like matplotlibrc, so 'make the title bigger' is one line (opennest/export/report.py). A project made before this file existed gets the same defaults without it.
_matplotlibrc_note: The house chart style. A project runs from its root and this file is in src/, so Open Nest points matplotlib at it (MATPLOTLIBRC, python_runner._child_environment) and every chart picks it up with no import and no setup call -- deterministic rather than dependent on the model writing one right line. It is a shipped file like the others, which means it is the child's to change.
_directories_note: data/ and notes/ are where a research project puts things it collects. The project already has a top-level data/ directory for imported datasets; these sit beside the analysis so a child can keep working notes next to the code that reads them.
